clayresearch.next_test: Maintain a dedicated prior-art map and rank the cheapest discriminators first. Treat executable-plus-database as prior art; novelty remains UNPROVEN until combination/mechanism novelty survives independent review.

frank.next_test: Compare self.root.udb against a split immutable-root/model plus mutable-state control using the same Frank v0.1 semantics. Preserve self.root identity as ROOT_ID plus admitted STATE_LINEAGE; physical unity must not redefine authority or truth.

claycode.next_test: Specify typed container/region identities, immutable-vs-mutable capabilities, bounded offset access and fail-closed region permissions. Prove lowering/runtime preserves these distinctions before any production promotion.

unifieddb.next_test: Build the smallest executable discriminator with redundant superblocks, append-only/state-COW recovery, ROOT_ID and STATE_HEAD separation, then run crash/fault/rollback tests against a stock split-layout control. Do not assume stock SQLite is the physical EUDI format.

claygraph.next_test: Keep graph/topology projections rebuildable and non-authoritative. Test that graph corruption/rebuild cannot alter ROOT_ID, canonical STATE_HEAD, model bytes, truth promotion or effect authority.

gwt.next_test: Run matched split-layout versus EUDI trials through candidate-selection-broadcast-delivery-use-outcome-reentry traces. Storage placement must not itself mint salience, truth or authority.

hyperposition.next_test: Verify unresolved alternatives and competing state branches retain explicit identities across snapshot, rollback, compaction and container rematerialization; no physical co-location may collapse semantic alternatives.

emergenz.next_test: Use EUDI only as a substrate intervention. Any behavioral difference requires lesion/replay/control analysis and is not evidence of consciousness or emergence by itself.

harness.next_test: Create target-VPS EUDI-E1..E10 tests: boot/memfd handoff, embedded-model differential, ETXTBSY boundary, kill-at-every-commit crash campaign, corruption injection, upgrade/rollback, security/authority attack, backup economics, causal differential and sustained run.

q23.next_test: Measure embedded aligned GGUF/model and multimodal asset access against external-file controls for mmap/page-fault/TTFT/tokens-per-second/RSS/GPU-offload behavior. Preserve exact model and percept provenance identities.

atomic.next_test: Search for simpler self-image boot/recovery designs, but reject any candidate that allows mutable evidence to become executable, expands corruption blast radius without recovery proof, or weakens OS-level isolation without compensating evidence.
